item.title: Boots Signs With GRP Tires
item.description: GRP Tires is excited to announce the signing of Elliott Boots to the factory team for 2026.

item.title: Beach RC and Dynamic Performance RC Announce Partnership
item.description: BeachRC x Dynamic Performance RC are now partners! By combining their warehouses, shipping networks, and inventories, they are creating a one-stop-shop powerhouse for the RC industry.

item.title: New R1 Wurks R1B Teaser Photos
item.description: R1 Wurks has a 2wd buggy platform on the way and they have shared their first teaser photos of the R1B decked out in dirt trim.

item.title: 2026 Clash of Champions Results
item.description: This past weekend the 2026 racing season kicked off with the annual Clash of Champions hosted by Hoosier RC Hobbyplex, check out the podiums here.

item.title: New JConcepts 1/8th Truggy Injection Molded Front Wing
item.description: JConcepts unveiled a new option part for the 1:8th truggy classes during the 2025 racing season. The new injection molded front wing is lightweight, has an uncompromised design with an exclusive JConcepts fit and finish.

item.title: New Whitz Racing Wideopen 1/10th Tires
item.description: Whitz Racing is ready to release their next loose dirt 1/10th scale 2.2" tire for off-road and oval racing with the Wideopen tires.

item.title: Kaerup Joins Team Savox
item.description: Team Savox is excited to announced that World Champion Marcus Kaerup has joined the team.

item.title: Cavalieri Joins Hot Race Tires
item.description: Hot Race is super happy to add to their family an RC legend and former World Champion, Ryan Cavalieri, for 2026/2027 seasons.

item.title: New Team Xray Carbon Upper Front Bumper Holder
item.description: Team Xray has released a new X4 Carbon upper front bumper holder for the new uni bulkheads.

item.title: Champlin Joins Flysky RC
item.description: Broc Champlin has joined Flysky RC for 2026 starting at this past weekends Clash of Champions.
